Cassandra was once Calina, the Goddess of Love. She resided in the heavens with the other gods, and was set to be married to Illuman.
She loved Illuman dearly, as much as she should, it was real and honest. They were wed and Calina discovered Illuman did not feel the same. He did not love her, or anyone but himself. He only married her to create a new generation of gods, and use those gods to create his own pantheon. He wanted to establish himself as the new Shao Daraan, and lead his pantheon to destroy the old, and take control of creation and the Light of Shao himself.

This drove Calina mad, and she fled Illuman's embrace. Illuman captured her, forcing her to submit to him, but she was mad, and lost her domain of love falling to true insanity. She was driven mad by the lie of love, for how could love between mortals exist if it didn't between the gods themselves?

Cassandra was cast out of the heavens for her failure to maintain her domain, and Illuman was disgusted by her fall from love, believing her to be unworthy of godhood. He took her divinity away from her and sent her to live on Terra-Nova among mortals.

She traveled and ended up in Lazarus, marrying him and having a child (Titus). Titus was supposed to be her grand creation to fulfill her plan and enact her revenge, but he was weak, and not what she needed. She then had a child with Titus called Augustus, who had a much stronger connection to her divinity, and was exactly what she had been waiting for. She led Augustus and raised him as a great warrior and king, grooming him for her dark plans.

SO what is Calina/ Cassandra's plan?
She is part of the Forgotten. She and Khal Daraan are two forgotten gods, and she has been communing with the deep dark being trapped within the center of the world.
 Calina wants to free Khal, but first she must become a god again.

BECOMING A GOD: She plans to use Augustus to become a god once again, as she cannot mantle into the domain of Arkonil as she and her are both technically fallen gods. She wants Augustus to mantle into Arkonil, and then she will kill Augustus and mantle into his domain. She has prepared Augustus for his path since birth. She has given him an unbreakable sense of purpose and drive to do this, which he believes is saving the world. What it actually is though, is that he will kill trillions of people in order to mantle into the domain of Arkonil, and become a god.

See Mantling for more info.

FREEING KHAL DARAAN: Khal Daraan is essentially hibernating at the center of the earth. In order to be freed he must be reawakened using the Eyes of Ouroboros. The eyes must be used after traversing the Castle of Shadows (a massive dungeon), and looking at Khal Daraan with the eyes. The Eyes of Ouroboros are the eyes of a long forgotten and dead god that was the spawn on Khal, and thus have the power to reawaken him specifically. The eyes are in the possession of Elijah, Augustus' friend.
